title: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Launches This November
summary: Nintendo's huge remake joins Grand Theft Auto VI in November for a potent 1-2 punch. - Game Informer
text: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Launches This November Skip to main content Twitter Facebook Instagram Twitch YouTube TikTok Main navigation Read the Magazine News Reviews Previews Features Videos Podcasts 2026 Release List SUBSCRIBE Search: Type: - Any - Product Preview Review Items per page: 10 20 50 100 Sort by: Most Relevant Oldest first Newest first Follow Us Twitter Facebook Instagram Twitch YouTube Tiktok Share Follow Us Close --> Share Close Post Tweet Email https://gameinformer.com/nintendo-direct/2026/09/08/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-launches-this-november Copy Link Follow Us Close Twitter Facebook Instagram Twitch YouTube nintendo direct The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Launches This November by Wesley LeBlanc on Sep 08, 2026 at 09:39 AM Share Facebook Post Twitter Tweet Email Email Comment Comment The Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time finally has a release date, and it launches on November 5, 2026, exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2. This release date puts the remake launching just two weeks before Grand Theft Auto VI , which is anticipated to be the biggest game launch of the year . Nintendo seems to know the cachet The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has, though, and many gamers will likely pick up this remake in November, whether they're picking up GTA VI later that month or not. The company revealed this November 5 release date during today's Legend of Zelda Nintendo Direct , ahead of the more general Nintendo Direct airing tomorrow, September 9. As you can see, this remake dramatically changes the visual style of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which originally launched more than two decades ago on Nintendo 64. This new style feels more modern and sits somewhere in the realm of stylized realism, compared with the original game's more polygonal look, which was shaped by the console's constraints. Get a more extensive look at the remake in the trailer for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time below (though heads up: if you haven't played the game, this trailer shows a lot ): The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time launches exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5.
